# Planted bugs of orgid (scripts/go-mutants.sh client/orgid/testdata/mutants.txt,
# make test-go-mutants, in make ci): each line "<mutant> | <file> | <exact
# line text> | <replacement> | <test>"; the lines of one mutant are applied
# together and its test must then fail. The verifier's and the machine
# identity's mutants of org/orgpki, orgmachine and orgenrol, moved with
# their code. Models: spec/proverif/enrol.pv and spec/enrol/Enrol.tla
# (no-expiry-timer: NoExpiredSession; no-cut-on-update, reload-skips-crl:
# RevocationBound; push-only: TakesEffect; crl-no-wake-on-rotation:
# MachinesFollowRotation), spec/orgmove/OrgHosted.tla and
# spec/proverif/orghosted.pv (until-leaf-only: DelegationBound, finding F1;
# ignore-root-crl, root-crl-unsigned, reload-skips-issuers, keep-sessions:
# RevokedIssuerRefused), spec/proverif/e2ee_tcp.pv (the client's name and
# check, the group). Not here: the issuer's (org/orgpki), keep-old-root
# (the verifier holds one root: TakeRotation replaces it).
